pages.text: A gem is a beautiful stone. People have loved gems for a very long time.
Most gems are minerals. Minerals are made by nature, and they are not alive.
Many gems are crystals. The tiny parts inside a crystal line up in a neat pattern.
Many gems grow slowly underground. Heat and pressure help them form.
A geode looks like a plain rock. Inside, it is lined with sparkling crystals.
A gem cutter shapes and polishes a rough stone. The flat faces, called facets, catch the light.
A diamond is made of carbon. It is the hardest natural material.
Rubies and sapphires are the same mineral. Tiny bits of other elements give them different colors.
Amethyst is purple quartz. Quartz comes in many colors.
Opal flashes with rainbow colors. Tiny shapes inside it bend the light.
Some gems come from living things. Pearls grow inside oysters, and amber is tree sap that turned hard.
Our gems sparkle in the sun. Which one is your favourite?
